battle.name: 第二次粵桂戰爭
battle.theater: 廣西梧州、柳州、桂林與南寧一帶
battle.brief: 《中文維基戰爭列表》所載第二次粵桂戰爭於1921年7月展開，廣東軍與廣西軍在廣西境內爭奪控制權，戰事涉及梧州、柳州、桂林與南寧。交戰軍配備1870年已服役的婆塞德後膛砲（Breech-loading cannon），由砲兵提供火力支援。

kit.name: 婆塞德後膛砲
kit.history: 婆塞德後膛砲屬德國陸軍野戰砲兵裝備，與步兵協同，以曲射火力支援推進，並負責壓制火力點及攻擊堡壘。

countries: 第二次粵桂戰爭（1921）的兩個作戰主體，名義上同屬中華民國，實際上卻是彼此不相隸屬的省軍。東線是陳炯明掌握的粵軍，對抗以陸榮廷為首、帶有滇系色彩的廣西軍；廣州護法政府提供政治名分，卻沒有把兩個戰區置於同一名作戰指揮官之下。北洋政府沒有正式派兵參戰，外國也沒有在廣東、廣西投入地面部隊，因此這不是中國與外國之間的戰爭，而是中華民國內部省軍間的戰事。戰場集中在廣東西部與廣西東部的西江、梧州、靈山一帶，廣州與南寧則是各自的後方中心。
countriesEn: The two principal belligerents in the Second Guangdong–Guangxi War of 1921 were nominally part of the same Republic of China, but in practice they were independent provincial armies. On the eastern front, Chen Jiongming’s Guangdong forces fought the Guangxi army led by Lu Rongting, whose organization retained a strong Yunnan-clique character. The Guangzhou Constitutional Protection Government supplied political legitimacy but did not place the two theaters under a single operational commander. Neither the Beiyang government nor any foreign state committed organized ground forces in Guangdong or Guangxi. This was therefore a civil conflict between provincial armies within the Republic of China, fought chiefly around the Xijiang River, Wuzhou, and Lingshan, with Guangzhou and Nanning serving as their respective rear centers.
people: 陳炯明是粵方的政治與軍事核心，他既要維持廣東控制，也要處理桂東與西江沿線的防務；洪兆麟、鄧如琢等將領分別統率其麾下作戰單位，但各種戰報對第一軍、第二軍的番號、駐地與指揮交接記載不一，不能硬湊成一份始終如一的指揮表。陸榮廷是桂方首腦，譚浩明等雲南系將領則構成其政治及軍事支柱，劉日福是廣西軍的重要前線將領。廣西境內另有沈鴻英所部形成牽制，使陸榮廷難以把全部力量集中到粵東。孫文主持的廣州護法政府關注兩廣統一、軍費與北方計畫，但前線指揮仍分屬陳、陸二人，孫文不是此役的現場指揮者。
peopleEn: Chen Jiongming was the political and military center of the Guangdong side. He had to retain control of Guangdong while managing the defenses of eastern Guangxi and the Xijiang corridor. Generals such as Hong Zhaolin and Deng Ruzhuo commanded units under him, although surviving reports differ over the designations, stationing, and command transfers of the First and Second Armies, so they cannot be reduced to a single continuously reliable order of battle. Lu Rongting headed the Guangxi side, with commanders of the Yunnan clique such as Tan Haoming forming important political and military pillars, while Liu Rifu served as a significant Guangxi front-line commander. Independent forces under Shen Hongying also operated inside Guangxi, preventing Lu from concentrating every available unit against eastern Guangdong. Sun Yat-sen’s Guangzhou Constitutional Protection government followed the questions of unification, military finance, and northern planning, but operational command remained divided between Chen and Lu; Sun was not the battlefield commander of this war.
kits: 依1921年以前已在中國軍隊列裝的武器判斷，粵桂兩軍的火力核心是步兵。基層常用漢陽八八式步槍，少量德系裝備可用Gewehr 98，兩者均使用7.92×57公釐米子彈；部分單位另有Browning M1903輕機槍，使用.30-06英制彈。機關槍包括Maxim MG08系列水冷重機槍，配三腳架及足量水源。火炮可見Type 88 75毫米野砲及Type 13 75毫米野砲，配有炮架、雙輪前車、馬匹或人工挽具。步槍常用瞄具的有效距離約四百至六百公尺，七五毫米野砲通常在三至五千公尺內提供直射或曲射支援；砲彈分為破片及高爆兩類，Type 88與Type 13的火砲及炮彈須按規格分庫管理，不能只憑七五毫米口徑混用。軍官可能攜帶Mauser C96手槍，實際使用7.63×25毫米Mauser彈。彈藥箱、機槍彈藥盒、備用槍管、炮具附件由馬車或馱畜輸送，沿江轉運與山區馱運並行；有線電話、電報和信使負責指揮，不能假定前線已有統一無線電系統。
kitsEn: Judging from weapons already listed in Chinese service before 1921, infantry formed the firepower core of both armies. The standard rifle was the Hanyang Model 88, while some German-equipped units used the Gewehr 98; both fired 7.92×57mmR ammunition. Some units also held Browning M1903 light machine guns chambered for .30-06 ammunition. Machine-gun strengths included the water-cooled Maxim MG08 series, operated from tripods and requiring a reliable local water supply. Artillery consisted principally of Type 88 and Type 13 75mm field guns, together with gun carriages, two-wheel limbers, and horse or manpower teams for towing. The practical effective range of the infantry rifle with service sights was approximately 400 to 600 meters, while the 75mm guns normally provided direct or curved fire within roughly 3,000 to 5,000 meters. Shells included shrapnel and high-explosive types, and Type 88 and Type 13 ammunition had to be managed according to the appropriate weapon specification rather than treated as interchangeable simply because both guns were 75mm. Officers might carry the Mauser C96 pistol, firing 7.63×25mm Mauser ammunition. Ammunition boxes, machine-gun belts, spare barrels, and gun equipment traveled by wagon or pack animal, with river transport used alongside mountain pack trains. Command depended on field telephones, telegraph lines, and couriers; a common wireless network could not be assumed at the front.
tactics: 兩軍作戰以步兵縱隊和散兵線為主，並非現代化機動作戰。前進時通常先以哨兵與游騎探明道路、渡口及村落外圍的高地，再由連、排分散展開，利用短距離射擊壓制守軍，接近後以刺刀、手榴彈和密集射線解決戰鬥。進攻常利用夜間移動避開直射火力，在清晨或白晝短時間內投入兵力；道路狹窄處則採逐段封鎖，使防守者不能同時使用全部火力。防守方偏好控制山口、河流渡點與道路轉折，以交叉射界配置機槍，七五毫米砲則對道路縱列和後方集結地施射破片彈，攻擊工事時改用高爆彈。山區道路受二月以後華南雨季影響，泥濘會拖慢炮車和糧秣輸送，因此炮彈、機槍備件及軍糧常需由馱畜分批送往前沿。指揮命令從省城經電報或汽車轉到軍部，再由軍部派員或信使送至前線；道路距離、通訊延誤與各軍自行補給，使局部勝利很難迅速轉為全線突破。
tacticsEn: Both armies fought primarily with infantry columns and skirmish lines rather than modern combined-arms methods. During an advance, scouts and mounted patrols normally reconnoitered roads, river crossings, and the heights outside settlements before companies and platoons deployed in dispersed formations. Short bursts of rifle fire suppressed defenders, and the struggle was brought to close range with bayonets, grenades, and concentrated fire. Offensives often used movement at night to avoid direct fire and committed troops during a short period around dawn or daylight. At narrow roads, both sides attempted to seal the route section by section so that a defender could not bring all weapons to bear. Defenders generally preferred heights, fords, and road bends, interlocking machine-gun fields along crossing lines. The 75mm guns fired shrapnel against road columns and rear assembly areas, switching to high-explosive shells against positions and obstacles. In the mountains, rains beginning during the second month turned roads to mud and slowed artillery, ammunition, and military supply trains, so shells, spare machine-gun parts, and provisions often had to be carried forward by pack animals in several loads. Orders traveled from the provincial capitals by telegraph or motor vehicle to army headquarters and then by staff officer or courier to the front. Road distances, delays in communication, and separate supply systems made a local success difficult to convert quickly into a general breakthrough.
data: 可核對的時序大致如下：1921年1月，粵方在廣州以西及三水、肇慶方向調集部隊，桂方則把兵力集中於南寧、鬱林及桂東的河流與道路附近，準備決定西江下游的控制。2月，肇慶至梧州一線爆發大規模接觸，雙方先以砲火及步兵試探陣地，戰線很快越過省界。3月，戰報對粵軍是否完整占據梧州，以及桂軍向鬱林、靈山反擊的先後記載不一，但可確定粵軍曾取得桂東的臨時陣地，另一條戰線則沿高州、化州、信宜通向靈山。4月，雙方在河谷、山口與後方補給線附近反覆攻守，桂軍利用縱深調兵，粵軍則試圖以西路和西路之間的轉移牽制桂軍。5月，陸榮廷與陳炯明方面達成停戰，主要部隊分批退回原省；少數戰報把最後的交接記至6月初。交戰地域包括廣東的肇慶、信宜及廣西的梧州、鬱林、靈山，但沒有一條界線始終固定。現存粵方、桂方戰報及地方資料對實際到隊人數、俘虜數和傷亡總數互相矛盾，因此不能引用單一數字冒充雙方都承認的損失。
dataEn: The broadly verifiable chronology is as follows. In January 1921, the Guangdong side concentrated troops west of Guangzhou and toward Sanshui and Zhaoqing, while the Guangxi side assembled around Nanning, Yulin, and the transport routes of eastern Guangxi in preparation for deciding control of the lower Xijiang. In February, major contact began along the Zhaoqing–Wuzhou line. Artillery and infantry probing quickly carried the front across the provincial boundary. Accounts differ in March over whether the Guangdong army fully occupied Wuzhou and over the sequence of Guangxi counterattacks toward Yulin and Lingshan, but the Guangdong troops definitely held temporary positions in eastern Guangxi, while another operational axis ran from Gaozhou and Huazhou through Xinyi toward Lingshan. During April, both sides repeatedly attacked and defended in river valleys, mountain passes, and areas close to supply lines. Guangxi forces drew on interior reserves, while Guangdong troops attempted to fix the Guangxi army by moving between the western routes and the passes linking them. In May, Lu Rongting and Chen Jiongming reached a cessation, and the principal formations withdrew in stages toward their respective provinces. A few reports place the final transfers in early June. The theater included Zhaoqing and Xinyi in Guangdong and Wuzhou, Yulin, and Lingshan in Guangxi, but no single front line remained fixed. Surviving Guangdong and Guangxi reports and local records contradict one another over actual strengths, prisoners, and total casualties, so no single figure can be presented as a mutually accepted loss estimate.
cause: 戰爭的直接起因，是1920年岑春煊勢力退入桂東後，陳炯明率粵軍追擊，而陸榮廷、譚浩明又率帶有滇系背景的部隊進入廣西。岑氏殘部敗退後，陳、陸兩軍在梧州及西江沿線的控制問題上直接相鄰；陳軍希望鞏固肇慶與桂東的推進成果，桂軍則必須收回受威脅的城鎮和交通線，並阻止粵軍繼續伸入廣西。較深層的原因是省軍化的政治結構：軍隊、徵發、稅收、軍械庫存與地方控制互不分離，兩方都擔心對方先取得西江航運、桂東地盤和粵桂邊界兵力，因而把防衛變成主動進攻。孫文主持的廣州政府又想推動兩廣整合與北方計畫，使軍費、購械及最高指揮權的爭奪更加敏感。這是一場省軍為資源、邊界與生存空間而打的內戰，不存在單一可直接引戰的公開事件。
causeEn: The immediate background was the convergence of hostile forces in eastern Guangxi after Cen Chunxuan’s forces withdrew there in 1920. Chen Jiongming’s Guangdong army pursued Cen’s remnants, while Lu Rongting and Tan Haoming entered Guangxi with troops closely connected to the Yunnan clique. After Cen’s position collapsed, the control of Wuzhou and the Xijiang corridor brought the Chen and Lu armies directly into contact. The Guangdong troops sought to consolidate their advance through Zhaoqing and eastern Guangxi, while Guangxi forces had to recover threatened towns and lines of communication and prevent further penetration from Guangdong. A deeper cause was the provincialized structure of politics and war: armed forces, mobilization, taxation, arsenals, and local control could not be separated. Each side feared that its opponent would secure the Xijiang transport route, eastern Guangxi, and forces along the provincial border first, turning a defensive need into an offensive one. The Guangzhou government under Sun Yat-sen also pursued greater integration of the two provinces and northern planning, intensifying disputes over military finance, procurement, and supreme command. The conflict was thus an internal war for resources, boundaries, and a secure military livelihood, not one precipitated by a single public incident.
impact: 戰爭在軍事上沒有造成永久性的省界改變，卻消耗了雙方大量槍彈、馬匹、軍械與時間。粵軍雖能越過省界奪取若干城鎮和山區陣地，卻難以把局部突破擴展為對南寧或廣西全省的控制；桂軍能以縱深和內線調兵反擊，卻同樣無法把桂東戰果延伸成對廣東的長期占領。戰後，陳炯明的財政、兵員補充及彈藥周轉更為吃緊，孫文對廣東軍隊權力過於集中的疑慮隨之加深，兩人的政治合作至1922年轉為公開破裂。陸榮廷的壓力也不只在粵東，廣西內部的地方武裝及沈鴻英等勢力仍能另行活動，使桂系中央控制難以恢復。劉日福等桂系將領在1922年的立場轉變，以及陳炯明後來發動兵變，均與戰後兩省力量重新排列有關，但不宜把這次戰爭視為所有後續事件的單一原因。
impactEn: Militarily, the war produced no permanent alteration of the provincial boundary, but it consumed large quantities of ammunition, horses, military equipment, and time on both sides. Guangdong troops could cross into Guangxi and seize individual towns and mountain positions, yet they could not convert local penetrations into control of Nanning or all Guangxi. Guangxi forces could counterattack from their interior and exploit interior lines, but they likewise could not extend gains from eastern Guangxi into a lasting occupation of Guangdong. After the fighting, Chen Jiongming faced tighter finances, difficulty replacing troops, and acute ammunition constraints. Sun Yat-sen’s suspicions of excessive military control in Guangdong deepened, and their political cooperation deteriorated into open rupture in 1922. Lu Rongting’s difficulties were not confined to the eastern front: local armed groups and independent forces such as Shen Hongying’s continued to operate within Guangxi, preventing effective restoration of central control by the Guangxi clique. The alignment shifts of commanders such as Liu Rifu in 1922 and Chen Jiongming’s later mutiny were connected to this postwar redistribution of power in the two provinces, although the war should not be treated as the single cause of every subsequent event.
result: 停戰的主要結果是主要作戰單位退出對方省境：桂軍放棄在廣東取得的據點，粵軍也撤出桂東的臨時占區，雙方重新以省界和西江下游為分界。陳炯明繼續控制廣東，陸榮廷仍保有廣西的表面的政治與軍事地位，但其中央權威已受到內部勢力削弱；從控制土地的角度看，沒有一方永久兼併另一省。戰役過程中曾有奪取渡口、山口和城鎮的局部勝負，但沒有發生一方主力被完整殲滅、另一方隨即取得全省的結果。傷亡、俘虜與重武器損失均無雙方一致且可核實的總數，任何精確傷亡數字都應保留不用。戰略上雙方各有短暫得手之處，戰略結果可作有限勝負看待；戰略目標則因兩省疆界大致恢復而陷入停滯，耗損反而成為最確定的結果。
resultEn: The principal result of the cessation was the withdrawal of the main formations from opposing territory. Guangxi troops gave up positions in Guangdong, and Guangdong troops withdrew from temporary footholds in eastern Guangxi, restoring the provincial boundary and the lower Xijiang as the practical dividing line. Chen Jiongming retained control of Guangdong, and Lu Rongting preserved the outward political and military position in Guangxi, although independent local forces further weakened his central authority. In terms of territory, neither province permanently absorbed the other. The campaign produced local gains in the form of captured crossings, passes, and towns, but neither side saw the destruction of the opposing main army followed by the occupation of an entire province. No mutually accepted and verifiable totals exist for casualties, prisoners, or heavy-weapons losses, so precise casualty figures should not be used. Tactically, each side achieved limited local successes; those results may be described as limited gains. Strategically, the war was inconclusive because the provincial boundaries were substantially restored, while exhaustion of ammunition, animals, money, and personnel was the most certain outcome.
